verses.1:
A Psalm of thanksgiving.
 Make a joyful noise to the LORD,
 all the earth.
verses.2:
Serve the LORD with gladness;
 come into His presence with joyful songs.
verses.3:
Know that the LORD is God.
 It is He who made us, and we are His; + 100:3 Or and not we ourselves 
 we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
